title: acgs_validator_registry_event/v1
description: Append-only validator lifecycle events (JSONL, one event per line). An empty registry is valid and trusts nobody. Every event carries an event_binding digest over its own content; a tampered line makes its validator unverifiable (fail closed). No event is ever edited or deleted — rotation and revocation are new events.

validator_identity.description: REGISTER only — the real person/organization. Never invented by software.

authorized_classes.description: REGISTER only — evidence classes this validator may attest.

appointment_authority.description: REGISTER only — who appointed this validator (real, externally evidenced).

key_id.description: REGISTER/ROTATE — signing key id (keystore file name).

key_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the key bytes; verification checks the keystore key against this.

effective_until.description: REGISTER — authority window end, null = open.

instant.description: ROTATE/REVOKE — logical instant the event takes effect (ISO-8601 Z).

event_binding.description: sha256(canonical(event minus this field)) — tamper evidence.
